name: Hoarder
description: AI-powered bookmark manager with automatic tagging, full-text search, and mobile apps for iOS and Android.

env.label: Application URL
env.description: Public URL where Hoarder will be accessible

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.description: Optional OpenAI key for AI-powered tagging (or use local Ollama)

env.label: Ollama Base URL
env.description: URL of your Ollama instance for local AI tagging (e.g. http://host:11434)

env.label: AI Text Model
env.description: Model name for AI tagging (OpenAI model or Ollama model name)

env.label: AI Image Model
env.description: Model name for AI image tagging (OpenAI model or Ollama model name)

env.label: Disable Signups
env.description: Disable new user registrations after creating your account

env.label: Max Asset Size (MB)
env.description: Maximum file upload size in megabytes
